This checkpoint introduces the shared lifecycle protocol and safe retired-body boundary. createnpc/createitem, corpse animation, projections, all eight larger features and the heartbeat/autoload worker are not yet connected to it.

The native lifecycle fixture uses real Character/Body objects and actual MySQL joins, serialized component/effect references and separate reader process. Persisted secondary Dead state is a correlation fixture, not an invocation of NPC.Die. Raw component XML tests physical reference retention without claiming actual corpse creation/decay.

The foreign GameItem is an actual persisted item and inventory/cell join. Explicit rehoming is fixture work; automatic native inventory/container/occupant evacuation and safe fallback are pending. Ordinary corpse Delete still has its existing destructive inventory path and is not qualified by this checkpoint.
The three modes are qualified as persistence policy and journal transitions, not the same native NPC template under all modes. N14/N15/N16 remain not_run for their full specified scenarios.
Sixteen repeated native body create/retire/complete cycles establish no accumulation of eligible body rows. They do not qualify high-volume NPC/AI/item/timer/subscription steady state.

Canonical NPC compaction/archival requires an explicit primary-body FK accommodation, preserved crimes/logs/witness/dub/corpse/effect attribution and non-loading tombstones. No canonical identity is deleted here; indefinite full actor/body graph retention is not an acceptable final solution.

Journal and exact-ownership rows currently retain lightweight evidence. Bounded retention/archival and post-death/remains-release integration are pending. Missing-death intents stay recoverable; the store does not infer death from absence or repeatedly call native Die.

Creation factories must register created entities before the atomic save and avoid their own saves, external effects and runtime exposure. Adapter implementation must preserve that contract; no factory/world activation adapter is claimed here.
Serialized-reference guards conservatively check known physical-body fields and fail closed on malformed XML. Arbitrary new Prog/component reference surfaces are not exhaustively inventoried.
N11 has controlled native quiet and three area-policy fixture evidence; installed stock, full source behavior, player command/network area flows and whole-session qualification remain pending.

Earthquake one-third caster/full allies-and-others, Chain Lightning repeated random hits/quarter caster, and room Fireball caster exclusion/ally inclusion are source-backed. The three-hit chain limit, grade*4 burning damage, 100-unit reserve, accelerated clock and deterministic checks/mastery/selection are provisional fixture choices.

Native layer/grounding/staff/plane adaptations are explicitly labelled provisional. Complete historical race/StoneSkin/EnergyShield filters, nearby Earthquake falls/messages, final hit counts/damage and other per-spell source policies require later stock authoring and native qualification.

The native fixture uses a concrete persisted Cell/Terrain and real Character/Body/Wound, wards, planar effect, compiled Prog and native SetAlly. Room/package catalogues, checks and output receiver spies are controlled. Cell membership changes directly at the payment commit seam; native Cell.Enter/Leave/movement, per-hit body/focus/membership mutations and production output filtering are not fully qualified by this fixture.

Physical siblings sharing a canonical identity are verified in the native writer with one payment/check.
